scope: 16 ranks, 8 layers, 3 ordinal samples; same rank/layer; runs are not matched workloads
method: Per pair residual = layer-window delta - indexer task duration delta - attention task duration delta. Median is computed after pairing. Task spans non-overlap within source windows.
limitations: residual is not a single operator or causal attribution
no end-to-end effect or achievable gain
no causal claim across unmatched input/cache/request
other streams and unobserved tasks may overlap
window boundaries and source attribution inherit input limitations
